description.value: The nə́c̓aʔmat ct Strathcona Branch is a Vancouver Public Library location serving the historic Strathcona neighbourhood at the edge of the Downtown Eastside. As a public library, it offers a welcoming, free indoor space where cyclists can rest, use public computers, and access resources. The branch name honours the Indigenous place name for the area, reflecting the community it serves.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack at 8m; rack at 10m; rack at 16m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a Cloudflare bot-verification page, providing no usable content — this is effectively a failed fetch. All amenity data must come from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms the library is part of the Vancouver Public Library system (operator:type=public), has opening_hours set, looks_closed=false, and carries internet_access=wlan; however, per the rules, OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative for amenity claims without website confirmation, so Wi-Fi is left null. No bike parking, washroom, or water tags are present in OSM.
concerns: Website fetch returned only a Cloudflare bot-verification page; no amenity or contact information could be confirmed from the site. All amenities are null.
OSM fixme tag notes 'unusual characters in name' — the Indigenous characters in 'nə́c̓aʔmat ct' may cause display or URL encoding issues in the directory.
pre_enrichment_exclude was set to true with reason 'prefetch_failed_stub'; the cached content (410 bytes) confirms the page was not successfully fetched.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a real, publicly accessible Vancouver Public Library branch — a free indoor space useful to touring cyclists for rest, internet access, and shelter.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is a public library, which by nature is free to enter and publicly accessible. Amenities typical of VPL branches (washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging) could not be confirmed due to the failed website fetch and absence of OSM amenity tags. A manual check of the VPL website is recommended.

blurb: Vancouver Public Library branch in Strathcona, named for the Indigenous place name.
